violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Stored Out of Children's Reach (26 TAC §747.4813(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Stored Out of Children's Reach
violation_type.typical_finding: There is a wood sheet sitting on top of a gate and there is a turtle in the wading pool in the gate filled with water in the backyard where the children play.
